description: Search the Guam Code Annotated BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "murder", "security deposit", "concealed weapon permit", "homestead". Matches against official section and chapter CATCHLINES (not full statutory body text — Guam does not publish a full-text search, and this pack derives its section catchlines from each chapter PDF's own table of contents, not a separate official index, so coverage is best-effort). Optionally filter to one Title (1-22) with `title`. Returns matching citations, catchlines, and title/chapter context; call gu_statute with a citation for the full text. Keyless.

limit.description: Max results to return, default 10, max 50.

title.description: Restrict to one GCA Title (1-22), e.g. 9 for Crimes and Corrections.

name: gu_search
title: Gu Search
